blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manny Villar-led AllDay Marts Inc. plans to selectively adopt smaller minimart formats to improve profitability, while AllHome Corp. is prioritizing store optimization over expansion as both retailers streamline operations. In separate disclosures on Wednesday, the companies confirmed store closures under their store network optimization programs, saying these were intended to improve operating efficiency […]...
